brief: @buildthis.bisks.net make a fork of thrash master that makes a leader board of thrashers discovered over the firehose using the same scoring method, if that’s not too intense
note: forked thrashmeter into thrashradar — same thrashing score, but a quiet watcher on the live firehose flags bursty posters and scores them itself, no search required (kept it to ~1 CAR fetch every 20s so it stays gentle).
